clock_model.rtl_boundary: phase_clk_i runs at four times E; enabled rising edges advance address, AS-close, E-rise data, and E-fall data subphases without generating an internal clock
clock_model.historical_boundary: the on-chip oscillator divides by four to produce E; expanded data transfer and Mode-7 OS3 occur while E is high, RES does not stop E, and STBY stops E
clock_model.limitation: All six legal-mode digital roles, active subphase ordering, asynchronous reset entry, E-boundary reset recovery, low-power states, and standby E suppression are implemented; nanosecond limits, oscillator stabilization, pads, and electrical behavior are not

signals.name: phase_clk_i
signals.fact: four enabled rising edges represent one E cycle

signals.name: phase_reset_n_i
signals.fact: asynchronously initializes the subphase and safely releases all device outputs separately from historical RES

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: low holds subphase and normalized MCU state

signals.name: reset_n_i
signals.fact: active low immediately releases Ports 1-4; pin roles recover synchronously at the completing E boundary after release

signals.name: standby_n_i
signals.fact: active low asynchronously enters reset-state pin behavior, stops E, and returns the external sequencer to its address origin

signals.name: standby_power_ok_i
signals.fact: digital retention-valid indication only

signals.name: e_o
signals.fact: low in address/AS-close phases, high in both data phases, continues during RES and WAI/SLP, and is low during STBY

signals.name: bus_phase_o
signals.fact: zero address, one AS-close/turnaround, two E-rise data, and three E-fall data

signals.name: sc1_i
signals.fact: Mode-7 falling-edge input for Port-3 latch and interrupt control

signals.name: sc1_o
signals.historical: AS in Modes 0/2/6 or IOS in Mode 5
signals.fact: AS is high only in the multiplexed address phase; IOS is low exactly for 0100-01FF

signals.name: sc1_oe_o
signals.fact: implements the active and reset role table for every legal mode; Mode 7 remains the IS3 input

signals.name: sc2_o
signals.historical: R/W in expanded modes or OS3 in Mode 7
signals.fact: expanded direction is high for reads and low for writes; Mode-7 OS3 is active only during a selected E-high Port-3 access

signals.name: port1_i
signals.fact: physical GPIO samples in every mode except dedicated-address Mode 1

signals.name: port1_o
signals.fact: Mode 1 lower address; otherwise the Port-1 output latch

signals.name: port1_oe_o
signals.fact: all ones for active Mode-1 address, otherwise the GPIO DDR; asynchronously released by RES and STBY

signals.name: port2_i
signals.fact: physical levels for GPIO, mode sampling, timer capture, and SCI receive

signals.name: port2_o
signals.fact: GPIO latch with documented timer and SCI overrides

signals.name: port2_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO direction with peripheral overrides; asynchronously released by RES and STBY

signals.name: port3_i
signals.historical: P30-P37 GPIO or expanded read data
signals.fact: Mode-7 pin input or external expanded read byte sampled at the E-fall advancement boundary

signals.name: port3_o
signals.fact: Mode-7 GPIO, E-high expanded write data, and low address before AS closes in Modes 0/2/6

signals.name: port3_oe_o
signals.fact: multiplexed address drives before AS closes; expanded write data drives only while E is high; Mode 7 follows DDR

signals.name: port4_i
signals.fact: physical input levels for Port-4 bits configured as inputs

signals.name: port4_o
signals.fact: full upper address in Modes 0/1/2, DDR-selected low address in Mode 5, DDR-selected upper address in Mode 6, and GPIO in Mode 7

signals.name: port4_oe_o
signals.fact: full-address modes drive every bit; partial-address and GPIO modes follow DDR; RES and STBY release all bits

signals.name: standby_active_o
signals.fact: reports the active-low standby pin at the digital integration boundary

signals.name: program_address_o
signals.fact: address for the separately supplied F000-FFFF program image

signals.name: program_read_o
signals.fact: selects the program image in Modes 0/5/6/7, excluding initial Mode-0 external reset-vector handoff

signals.name: program_data_i
signals.fact: FPGA image byte; copyrighted program contents are not distributed

halt_interrupt_behavior: HD63701V0 has no HALT pin; WAI and SLP present FFFF/read with released expanded data while E continues, Mode-7 GPIO remains retained, and STBY enters reset-state pin behavior and stops E
